title: Antibiotic Susceptibility: MIC, Breakpoints and Interpretation
subject: Microbiology
preview: MIC measures the lowest tested antimicrobial concentration preventing visible growth under standardized conditions.
quickRevision: MIC measures the lowest tested antimicrobial concentration preventing visible growth under standardized conditions.
Susceptible does not mean every drug is suitable at every infection site or in every patient.
Culture context, specimen quality and local guidelines prevent inappropriate treatment of colonization.

sections.title: Pathophysiology & identification
points: MIC measures the lowest tested antimicrobial concentration preventing visible growth under standardized conditions.
Clinical breakpoints classify susceptibility using microbiology, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics and clinical evidence.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: An MIC number cannot be interpreted without organism-drug-specific breakpoints and methods.

quiz.question: What is the MIC?
quiz.explanation: Minimum inhibitory concentration. MIC measures the lowest tested antimicrobial concentration preventing visible growth under standardized conditions.
